scenario: LEXP.7.19: `Bytes` has equality and no ordering, so `p.raw < p.prev` on two `Bytes` slots is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNORDERED_TYPE at the `<`. Both operands are the same type, so the refusal cannot be a cross-type mismatch. PATH PINNED: the comparison-step check in the validator (Mercury: `dsc.typecheck` `adjacent_mismatches`), on the ordering operator.

schema Pkt scope ttl 1_h:
    raw: Bytes
    prev: Bytes

rule r:

->
